text:
deploy-bot: Starting config-only rollout r-2026-03-microcfg (id:r-2026-03-microcfg) -> small routing/batching/limits tweak. Canary: 1% tenants for 10m.
deploy-bot: changes:
```
- routing_policy: prefer-closest-healthy -> prefer-healthy-az
- per_tenant_rate_limit: tiered 50r/s -> 40r/s (soft)
- batch_window_ms: 12 -> 8
- client_timeout_ms: 800 -> 750
```
deploy-bot: target clusters: us-west1/us-east1, rollout-window: 10m canary then ramp to 25%. release note id: RN-2026-03-07-microcfg
Mariah: watching p95/p99 and error counts on the rollout dashboard https://dashboards.internal/r/rollouts/r-2026-03-microcfg :eyes:
Tom (oncall): I'll monitor and keep the pager open for the next 30m. Threshold to abort: error rate +5% sustained for 5m or p99 +100ms baseline.
Jyoti: confirmed autoscaler settings unchanged. no infra migration.
Dani: will watch kv-cache hit rate and prefix-caching since batch window changed. if cache misses spike, we'll pause.
Priya (PM): quick fyi to support — no customer-visible feature changes, just perf settings. posting a short note to #support after canary.
obs-bot: Canary started (1%) — timestamp 1687654321. linking logs: https://logs.internal/q/r-2026-03-microcfg
Mariah: small blip in p99 for one tenant group at +60ms at t+3m, but single-host. investigating.
Dani: saw a correlated drop in kv-cache hit for that tenant (miss rate +4%). Likely warmup due to shorter batch window.
Tom (oncall): holding. if p99 stays > +50ms for >10m I'll ask deploy-bot to pause.
deploy-bot: Canary passed initial health checks at t+10m. Metrics: error-rate +0.2%, p95 +12ms, p99 +48ms. Proceeding to ramp to 25% over 5m.
Mariah: ramping to 25% now. tagging SRE for extra watch.
obs-bot: Ramp to 25% started (progress 1% -> 25%).
Dani: after ramp to 25% p99 is trending +75ms for a small subset of tenants using legacy KV prefixes. Not systemic but observable. Suggestion: revert per_tenant_rate_limit change for those tenants or restore batch_window to 10ms.
Jyoti: we can do a scoped revert on the rate limit flag for affected tenant group (flag id: rate-v2-scoped). Easier than full rollback.
Mariah: prefer scoped tweak first. roll action: revert rate limit only for tenant tag 'legacy-kv' and keep routing + batch_window change for everyone else.
deploy-bot: Applying scoped revert: unflag rate-v2-scoped for tag legacy-kv -> effective in ~45s.
obs-bot: Scoped revert applied. watching...
Priya (PM): pinging support with a note: "small perf tweak rolled back for a tiny subset — no customer action required."
Dani: post-revert p99 for that group fell back to baseline within 2m. overall cluster metrics stable.
Tom (oncall): no pager noise. good to continue.
Mariah: advancing rollout to 100% with the fix (rate limit revert for legacy-kv). final step will be tagging RN and archiving config diff. Proceeding in 10m windows.
deploy-bot: Ramp to 100% started. will report completion.
obs-bot: Rollout complete at 1687654525. Final metrics: global error-rate +0.1%, p95 +10ms, p99 +20ms.
Mariah: Great. capturing notes for release notes: rn-id RN-2026-03-07-microcfg. Changes: routing preference by AZ, batch window nudge (12->8ms), client timeout small reduction, scoped per-tenant limiter revert for legacy-kv.
Mariah: Follow-ups: add a short eval to ensure KV warmup on batch_window reductions, and run a 2-day canary on legacy-kv before reintroducing limiter change.
Dani: opening a quick ticket for an automated warmup check. link: https://tracker.internal/ISSUE-4321
Tom (oncall): thumbs up. I'll close the watch shift at +1h.
Priya (PM): leaving a short blurb in product changelog.
deploy-bot: Rollout closed. status: success. :white_check_mark:
Mariah: thanks everyone :tada:
